title: Nutritious Greek Lamb Skewers
description: A hearty and flavorful Greek dish featuring lamb skewers, natural yoghurt, and bonito flakes, perfect for a satisfying brunch
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together yoghurt, bonito flakes, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional bonito flakes and a side of natural yoghurt
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use
